summary: Rationale-only status update, validated as no_change with no effects, recording the final state without creating or duplicating records. With the two-voter vote repeat cited, every case in both investigations now has at least two executions from retained inputs. Configuration recovery (98ee8dfd5fac4b84915f91ed4b094bcf-question-0) cites eight receipts - single-voter recovery with flag-off controls, the three-voter commit-rule witness reproduced four times, the durable-snapshot corruption surviving a flag-off restart, the authority pair with its premise-failure repeat and premise-enforcing revision, and the two-voter vote boundary in two runs; replay completion (29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-question-0) cites eleven receipts - the block pair, the measured bound pair, the availability consequence at two batch sizes, the exact 128-delivered-batch boundary at two batch sizes, and default-configuration reachability. Both conclusions remain violated with the defects asserted, 54 claims across 14 receipts were verified against the observations with no discrepancy, both knowledge corrections are recorded with affected uses marked and gaps answered, and the one internal contradiction was repaired. Remaining limits are structural: in-memory transports and stores in one process, no production store, no process-level restart or disk fault, one prefix shape per scenario, and the snapshot-shipping propagation path unexercised; with the allocation nearly exhausted no uncitable probe is started, and expiry preserves this state.
